Container.Name: CodyWorker
Container.Overview: A build worker for the Cody container on this server. Cody's run_on_worker tool sends builds and tests here, so a runaway build is capped at this container's memory limit and the lowest CPU priority instead of taking memory from Cody or your other apps. Same image as Cody, started in worker mode: no web UI and no network port. Its sshd answers on a socket in a folder only the Cody container shares with it, so only Cody can reach it (key-only). Cody's home is mounted read-only, so jobs find every toolchain, venv and neighbouring repository at the path it has in Cody; what builds write to caches stays on this worker's own disk. Setup: docs/unraid.md, "Build worker".
Container.Requires: The Cody container: it shares the folder below and puts its public key there. Recommended: the zero-swap block for /boot/config/go in docs/unraid.md ("Build worker"), because Docker on Unraid ignores --memory-swap.

Config.Name: Worker disk
Config.Description: The worker's own disk: job copies, build folders kept between runs, and its own caches (cargo registry, npm, uv, ...).

Config.Name: Cody home (read-only)
Config.Description: Cody's home (its App Data folder + /home), shown read-only at /data/home inside each job: toolchains, venvs and neighbouring repositories at the same paths as in Cody.

Config.Name: Shared with Cody
Config.Description: The worker's door: its ssh socket and host key, and Cody's public key (authorized_keys). Inside Cody it is /data/workers/unraid.

Config.Name: Temp files
Config.Description: Kept off the Docker image so leftover test files cannot fill it.

Config.Name: Job slots
Config.Description: Jobs at once. Empty: a quarter of the CPUs.

Config.Name: Only when idle
Config.Description: 1: Cody sends jobs here only when this machine is otherwise idle.

Config.Name: Extra tools
Config.Description: name=/absolute/path pairs for tools that are not on PATH but that agents use at a fixed path, e.g. swift=/data/home/.cache/toolchains/swift/usr/bin/swift. Advertised when the path exists.

Config.Name: Extra caches
Config.Description: Further folders under Cody's home that builds write to (relative paths, e.g. go .cache/gradle-home). Each gets this worker's own writable copy, starting empty.

Config.Name: Extra packages
Config.Description: Debian packages installed when the container starts (downloads kept on the worker disk). The Cody image has no C compiler or make of its own.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for jobs, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Empty: UTC.
